title: Can Sybil's tracheal-deformity question be identified in NLST?
question: On recoverable Sybil-held-out NLST scans, is continuous minimum intrathoracic tracheal index preserved by Sybil preprocessing, stable across annual scans, and supported independently of sex, LAA-950 emphysema, lung volume, and reconstruction well enough to justify a future model-use experiment?
deliverable_original: Sybil is using saber-sheath tracheal deformity—the fixed side-to-side narrowing of the intrathoracic trachea—as a record of chronic obstructive lung injury.
deliverable_sentence: Eventual target, not testable at this stage: Sybil is using saber-sheath tracheal deformity—the fixed side-to-side narrowing of the intrathoracic trachea—as a record of chronic obstructive lung injury.
why_it_matters: A named, automatically measurable airway shape could make part of a lung-cancer model's signal legible. The present study asks only whether the obtainable data and model input preserve enough independent tracheal variation to make that use claim identifiable; it can prevent an attractive but confounded experiment from proceeding.

claim_boundaries.claimed_if_stage_0_passes: Only that a future controlled model-use experiment is technically and statistically askable in the inspected cohort.
not_claimed: That Sybil uses tracheal index or saber-sheath deformity.
That a score-index association establishes model use.
That high longitudinal stability establishes model use or chronic causation.
That tracheal deformity mediates smoking-related lung-cancer risk.
That covariate adjustment separates a constitutively entangled biological signal.
That results generalize beyond the inspected Sybil output and cohort.

rung.why: The four analyses are feasibility gates only. Even if every gate passes, no charter rung has been reached because no valid intervention tests model use.
rung.what_would_move_it_up: After all Stage 0 gates pass, rung 1 requires a validated in-distribution input-space tracheal-reshaping intervention on an untouched split. The edit must change continuous tracheal index, preserve all non-tracheal content within prespecified equivalence margins, pass a matched sham-edit tolerance, and produce the preregistered Sybil risk response. Rungs 2 and 3 additionally require exclusion of acquisition and population artifacts and support for the named anatomical interpretation.

X_measurement.X: Continuous minimum intrathoracic tracheal index: transverse lumen diameter divided by anteroposterior diameter on planes perpendicular to the tracheal centerline. Published categorical cutoffs (<0.67 and <=0.5) are descriptive only.
X_measurement.how: Automatically segment the tracheal lumen, extract its centerline, create perpendicular cross-sections from the lung apex to 2 cm above the carina, and take the minimum transverse/AP ratio using the procedure described by Pompe et al. (PMCID: PMC6052793).
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes. X is derived from image intensity, geometry, and a fixed formula without human concept annotation. Tool QC and agreement on NLST remain Stage 0 checks.

suspected_signal: Chronic obstructive mechanics may remodel the trachea anisotropically, producing fixed coronal narrowing relative to sagittal diameter rather than merely changing airway calibre.
specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Respiratory inflation, reconstruction kernel, gantry or neck angle, secretions, intubation, interpolation, crop loss, and anisotropic resampling can change the apparent ratio.
keystone_prerequisite: A recoverable Sybil-held-out or suitable external cohort must contain enough continuous tracheal-index variation that survives the complete Sybil preprocessing pipeline and has adequate joint support beyond sex, LAA-950 emphysema, lung volume, and reconstruction for a future intervention study.
keystone_evidence: Official Sybil code at commit d9fc81b93c1c6239a570c1c570c1f2a2e6266a4a was inspected and shows resampling to 0.703125 x 0.703125 x 2.5 mm followed by crop/pad to 256 x 256 x 200. Mikhael et al. (DOI: 10.1200/JCO.22.01345; PMCID: PMC10419602) report an NLST sample of 15,000 participants. Neither source establishes native-to-final-tensor tracheal-index agreement, held-out case linkage, longitudinal stability, or independent joint support.
keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? Equal target in-plane spacing and a large NLST cohort do not establish that the minimum centerline-perpendicular ratio survives interpolation and cropping, that the relevant segment remains in frame, that held-out cases are recoverable, or that low-index variation exists outside the male/COPD/emphysema tail. Those are the load-bearing assumptions.
rung_reached: No rung. A favorable Stage 0 result grants permission to design a use experiment; it is not evidence that Sybil uses X.

stage_0_gate.timing: Before measuring Sybil score associations, freeze cohort linkage rules, sampling, the primary index implementation, geometry-agreement margin, ICC criterion, covariates, support metric, minimum effective low-index sample, and all go/no-go thresholds.
inspect: Geometry preservation: paired continuous-index agreement between native NLST DICOM and Sybil's final tensor, including retention of the complete measured tracheal segment.
Split integrity: direct linkage of obtainable images to a released Sybil-held-out split, or a prespecified suitable external evaluation cohort, with no training cases in any score analysis.

Trait stability: within-subject continuous-index ICC across NLST T0/T1/T2 annual scans, with lung volume reported as an inflation-sensitive comparator and reconstruction differences handled prospectively.
Joint support: effective continuous-index support after conditioning on sex, LAA-950 emphysema, lung volume, and reconstruction kernel, including a prespecified minimum effective low-index sample.
stage_0_gate.decision: GO to intervention feasibility only if every gate passes. Failure of geometry preservation or independent joint support is a decisive feasibility negative for this Sybil/NLST route. Unrecoverable held-out linkage is a data-access stop. Low ICC weakens the fixed-remodeling mechanism but does not test model use.

dies_like_prior: The principal precedent is idea 009: a mechanically meaningful quantity was not identifiable apart from co-varying population factors. Gate four is the explicit lives-or-dies-like-009 test; this candidate is different only if direct inspection finds adequate tracheal-index support beyond sex, emphysema, lung volume, and reconstruction. It does not share the annotation-provenance failures of ideas 001, 002, 003, or 005 because X and the primary Stage 0 readouts require no human concept labels. It avoids idea 006's out-of-distribution deletion because no model intervention occurs at this stage, but a future edit would inherit the intervention-validity burden of ideas 008, 011, and 014.

closest_prior_work.citation: Mikhael PG et al., Sybil, J Clin Oncol 2023;41:2191-2200
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Sybil predicts future lung cancer from a single low-dose chest CT and was developed using an NLST sample.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not measure tracheal index or establish model use of tracheal shape.

closest_prior_work.citation: Pompe E et al., CT quantification of tracheal abnormalities in COPD
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The primary full text describes an automated centerline/perpendicular-plane tracheal-index procedure and reports 11 categorical saber-sheath cases among 200 COPDGene participants.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not study a lung-cancer model, Sybil preprocessing, or model reliance.

closest_prior_work.citation: Sobieski B et al., Auditing Sybil: Explaining Deep Lung Cancer Risk Prediction Through Generative Interventional Attributions
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The inspected primary preprint intervenes on nodules and reports artifact sensitivity and radial bias.
closest_prior_work.delta: It does not measure or intervene on tracheal shape.

novelty_statement: No novelty claim is made. A bounded primary-source search found no direct Sybil/tracheal-index study, but absence was not exhaustively established; status is NO_DUPLICATE_FOUND_LIMITED_SEARCH.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: Run only the four frozen Stage 0 audits on a recoverable Sybil-held-out or suitable external cohort. Continuous index is primary; categorical cutoffs are descriptive. Do not perform any representation intervention, score-based model-use test, or image edit.
smallest_decisive_experiment.primary_decision: Whether all four gates jointly permit development of a future controlled input-space intervention.
smallest_decisive_experiment.positive_interpretation: Passing all gates means only that the use question is askable in this route.
smallest_decisive_experiment.negative_interpretation: Failure of the prespecified native-to-tensor agreement margin or independent-support threshold decisively stops this route. Low longitudinal stability weakens the fixed-remodeling premise. Held-out linkage failure is a data-access result. None is a negative finding about what Sybil uses.

use_vs_association: Stage 0 does not test use. Neither correlation with Sybil score, high ICC, nor covariate-adjusted association may be presented as evidence of use. Only a later validated in-distribution tracheal-reshaping intervention with preservation, sham, equivalence, and untouched-split controls could reach rung 1.

claim_identifiability.scanner_vendor_site_protocol_reconstruct: Reconstruction is included in the joint-support audit; scanner, vendor, protocol, and site are tabulated where available. Masked or unavailable site prevents site-level exclusion and limits any future rung-2 claim.
claim_identifiability.positioning_and_respiratory_state: Centerline-perpendicular measurement reduces gantry and neck-angle bias. Annual repeat stability and lung-volume comparison test whether X behaves like fixed remodeling rather than an unstable inflation measurement, without pretending to isolate every respiratory effect.
claim_identifiability.body_habitus: Sex and lung volume are mandatory joint-support variables; an automatically measured thoracic or body-size proxy is descriptive if available. Residual habitus confounding remains for any later association.
claim_identifiability.disease_prevalence_and_referral: NLST's screening pathway narrows referral variation but represents heavy smokers. The support audit asks whether X varies independently within that population; it does not establish transportability.
claim_identifiability.label_leakage: X is computed from pixels and no report or cancer label enters any Stage 0 endpoint. Held-out linkage is nevertheless mandatory before inspecting model scores to avoid training-case contamination.
claim_identifiability.remaining_alternatives_after_stage_0: Even after all gates pass, sex-linked anatomy, COPD severity, emphysema, smoking injury, habitus, site, and unmeasured acquisition factors can still explain an observational score-index association. Stage 0 rules none of these into a model-use claim.

anticipated_negative.classification: mixed: decisive feasibility negatives and sensitivity-limited model-use nulls
anticipated_negative.meaningful_negative: Agreement outside the frozen native-to-tensor margin decisively shows that this implementation cannot measure the same X at Sybil input. Independent support below the frozen effective-sample threshold decisively shows that the obtainable cohort cannot separate X from the named dominant correlates. Low ICC is decisive against treating X as a stable trait under the chosen threshold, though not necessarily against all chronic remodeling.
anticipated_negative.non_decisive_negative: A null score-index association is sensitivity-limited and is not a test of use. Held-out linkage failure and segmentation failure are access or tool-feasibility outcomes, not evidence against the biological or model-use hypothesis.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Remodeling of a pressure-loaded cartilaginous tube.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: A stable anisotropic transverse/AP ratio rather than generic airway calibre.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The study would measure generic tracheal size and would not require longitudinal trait stability. The mechanics hypothesis selects anisotropy, predicts the ratio's direction, and makes stability a falsifiable gate.

data_and_compute.data: Candidate imaging source is publicly downloadable NLST CT through TCIA/IDC with limited clinical data. Exact linkage to the released Sybil-held-out split, repeat-scan counts, and required covariate availability remain uninspected gates; the study must not depend on unconfirmed DUA-gated variables.
data_and_compute.model: Official Sybil code and released checkpoint, pinned by commit and checksum before any score analysis.
data_and_compute.compute: Automated geometry measurements and limited frozen-model inference are compatible with single-GPU sessions; no model training is proposed.

remaining_legwork: Inspect and join actual Sybil split identifiers to obtainable NLST images; freeze a held-out or external cohort before score access.
Prespecify numeric geometry agreement, ICC, joint-support, effective-sample, and missingness thresholds before measurement.
Verify that required sex and reconstruction fields are public and compute emphysema and lung volume automatically without human adjudication.
Power the low-index support audit using the continuous distribution rather than categorical saber-sheath prevalence.
If and only if all gates pass, prepare a separate feasibility memo for an in-distribution tracheal-reshaping editor; no probe code is authorized.

mechanism_clarity.why: The suspected quantity is a specific anatomical ratio with a predicted direction, mechanical interpretation, and automatic measurement.

identifiability.why: Stage 0 can identify whether the question is askable but cannot identify model use; the dominant biological correlates may be inseparable in NLST.

interest.why: A mechanically remodeled trachea as a latent smoking-injury signal is surprising and physician-legible.

medical_relevance.why: It could clarify a lung-cancer risk model's residual signal, but this stage produces no clinical or model-use conclusion.

clarity.why: One Stage 0 question asks whether one continuous X survives preprocessing and has stable, independent support.

feasibility.why: Capped because the keystone is NOT_INSPECTED. The audits are modest, but held-out linkage and public covariates remain uncertain.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped because the keystone is NOT_INSPECTED and the no-duplicate finding comes from a bounded search.

prior_legwork.why: The model, official preprocessing, public imaging route, longitudinal scans, and automatic measurement method exist; their exact join has not been inspected.

data_readiness.why: NLST images are public, but held-out identifiers, usable repeats, covariates, and support counts have not been directly joined.

evaluation_readiness.why: Agreement, ICC, and support analyses are standard, but their numeric go/no-go thresholds still require prospective specification.

negative_result_value.why: Geometry or joint-support failure decisively stops this route, while score-association nulls and several access failures remain non-decisive about model use.

regret.why: A relatively cheap audit can prevent a confounded intervention project and may unlock a highly legible use question.

unverified_claims: The released Sybil-held-out NLST cases can be linked to publicly obtainable images.
Sybil preprocessing preserves continuous minimum tracheal index within a defensible margin.
Continuous tracheal index is longitudinally stable enough to represent fixed remodeling.
Adequate index support remains beyond sex, LAA-950 emphysema, lung volume, and reconstruction.
recommendation: REVISE COMPLETE; proceed only to a feasibility memo that freezes the four Stage 0 gates. No probe code or model-use claim is authorized.
